headline: No rung moved under v2. fl_forager_gene's uptake gene shifts against its neutral marker (5/6 vs 0/6 runs; exact one-sided p 0.021, not 0.008), but in the only imaged seed the sweep runs through in-body takeover after a mutation patch and fusion relabelling with 0 births, so it rates L4b[L2] with L7 Weak (low). fl_predator shows real engulfment and lagged prey-to-predator peaks, but its ablations are single-seed and unmatched, and predators died on the skeptic's seed 11: L4b[L2], L5 Weak. Continue, narrowed to a Price-split audit of whether selection here is carried by bodies or by matter.
message_to_researcher:
Decision: CONTINUE, narrowed (promise 6/10). No rung moved under v2.

What convinced us. The uptake gene shifts while the neutral marker does not (5/6 runs vs 0/6), and high-g bodies take the body count in seeds 2, 4 and 5. fl_predator has real engulfment and correctly signed ablations. Your negatives were reported honestly.

What did not.
- fl_forager_gene: L4b[L2]. L7 Weak (low); L6 Weak in this world. In seed 3, the only imaged seed, the central cell turns orange without dividing (t~780-940) after a mutation patch hits its lower lobe. A cyan glider then fuses into an orange cell and is relabelled. 0 persistent splits, gen 0. Per-parcel uptake (eat *= g) lets mutant parcels take a body over from inside. There is no ledger. The neutral arm is rate-matched, not identical-event (seed 0: 99 vs 83 events). The exact one-sided p for U=31 is 0.021, not 0.008: correct NOTEBOOK and REPORT.
- fl_predator: L4b[L2] (prey only). L5 Weak (near-Supported), L4c Weak. The ablations are single-seed and unmatched (8000 vs 12000 steps). The skeptic's seed 11 lost the predators by t~900. 1-3 peaks per seed are not cycles. Quote times in t, not steps.
- fl_predator_gene: L7 Contradicted.

Main experiment: is selection carried by bodies or by matter? 128², 12000 steps, 8 seeds per arm:
- S: the current gene.
- N: identical-event twin (mutation times and draws on their own RNG stream).
- S_body/N_body: the same pair, but uptake uses g_eff = blur_R(A*g)/blur_R(A) at kernel radius, so parcels in one body are neutral to each other.
Log each event's body and the fraction hit. Track bodies merge-aware every 20 steps. Keep a per-kind ledger: births, deaths, inter-kind merges, flips, conversions, off-kind daughters. Price-split d(mean log g) per interval into between-body (growth, fission, death), within-body and fusion terms. Classify each final high-g body as born, taken over after a patch, or fused. Pass: between > within+fusion in >=5/8 S seeds, births > conversions, twins ~0, deaths after colonization, gen>=2 with birth strips. Ship gene-coloured packs (2 seeds per arm). If only S_body passes, adopt it. If neither passes, call it L5 (infection) and add anti-fusion before any further mutation runs.

Secondary:
1. fl_predator: reference, chase=0, flee=0 and prey-only arms, 6 seeds, 12000 steps each. Use labkit META["species"]. Report signs, coexistence frequency, peak spacing and a 192² size check (not the 256² movie).
2. Resolution test (R_scale x2, flow x4) on one S seed and on fl_predator seed 0.
3. Log the first mutation draw per seed in fl_predator_gene to explain its upward drift.
Pause: coevolution, secreted-signal sensing, cost variants, new worlds, h doses.

Borrow:
- committee/reviews/autopoiesis_r2.md arm E;
- origin/claude/alife-autopoiesis:research/alife/threads/autopoiesis/kindtrack.py;
- origin/claude/alife-fisim-beyond-laplacian:research/alife/threads/fisim-beyond-laplacian/evo.py (shared-RNG twins);
- origin/claude/alife-chemotaxis-motility:research/alife/threads/chemotaxis-motility/fission.py (largest-parent rule);
- origin/claude/alife-active-droplets:research/alife/threads/active-droplets/packs/ad5-evolve (conversion audit).

leaderboard_rows.note: Heritable uptake gene (eat *= g per parcel), moved with matter by stochastic sampling and mutated by radius-8 disks during the run. Final matter-weighted log g is +0.34..+0.73 in 5/6 selection runs vs -0.24..+0.11 in 6 rate-matched neutral runs (exact one-sided p=0.021, not the reported 0.008). High-g bodies take the body count in seeds 2, 4 and 5 (13/17, 21/21, 19/21). But in the only imaged seed (3) the central cell turns cream to orange without dividing after a mutation patch (t~780-940), and a cyan glider fuses into an orange cell and is relabelled; 0 persistent splits, gen 0. There is no births/deaths/conversions ledger, the neutral arm is not identical-event (seed 0: 99 vs 83 events), and the trait is the uptake rate itself (positive control). L7 Weak (low; Contradicted in seed 3); L6 Weak in this world. Gliders with food wakes early; winners become static multi-ring giants (also seen in one neutral run).

fl_forager gliders as prey plus a predator species that converts the prey matter it overlaps (mass-conserving) and decays to food. Chase and flee are imposed sigma-12 blurred-field sensing. Engulfment in every pack seed (seed 0 #355, #395, #497), and prey peaks lead predator rises in 3/3 seeds. Single-seed ablations run 8000 steps against 12000-step references: chase=0 starves the predators, flee=0 gives total extinction. Skeptic seed 11: predators extinct by t~900, prey x5.3. Coexistence 3/4 seeds at 1 of 9 parameter points; 1-3 peaks per seed, no grid-size check. L5 Weak (near-Supported); L4c Weak (decay by construction); L4b holds for prey only. labkit fuses the species. The heritable flee gene (fl_predator_gene, no pack, evo2/pgene.png) is L7 Contradicted: selection +0.16..+0.23 vs neutral +0.24..+0.29, with an unexplained upward drift in all arms.

cross_pollination.suggestion: Parcel-versus-body trap from flow-lenia r2. A matter-carried allele with a per-parcel growth advantage rose through in-body takeover after a sub-body mutation patch and through fusion relabelling, with 0 births in the imaged seed (fl_forager_gene seed 3, t~780-1020; judge montage judge-scratch/flow-lenia-r2-biologist/gene3_f36_58.png). evopursuit's radius-4 swap is also a matter-level operator, so add a Price split of the allele change (between-body births, deaths and growth vs within-body vs fusion) to the ledger you are already planning. For the fixed-allele partner arms, also consider flow-lenia's mass-conserving kill term, in which predator matter converts the prey matter it overlaps and decays to food. It gives lagged prey-to-predator peaks in 3/3 seeds and prey extermination without flee, so it is a true consuming predator, not an escort (origin/claude/alife-flow-lenia:research/alife/threads/flow-lenia/worlds/fl_predator/world.py, packs/fl_predator/populations.png).

Independent support for your arm-E design (kinds neutral inside the cell). In Flow-Lenia, a gene that acts per parcel (eat *= g) let a single mutation patch take over an undivided giant cell within ~160 t (fl_forager_gene seed 3, t~780-940), and selection then bred static giants with 0 persistent splits. flow-lenia will run the same fix (a body-scale phenotype g_eff = blur(A*g)/blur(A)) with a between- vs within-body Price split. Use that split as arm E's readout too (origin/claude/alife-flow-lenia:research/alife/threads/flow-lenia/evo2/gene_all.png).

Apply a Price split to ad5-evolve's allele change: between-droplet division versus within-droplet takeover after the 5-px half-droplet transplant. Report the mutation footprint relative to the median body. In flow-lenia, a mutation disk smaller than the body created mosaic bodies that turned over from inside, and a matter-weighted mean hid this (fl_forager_gene; committee/reviews/flow-lenia_r2.md).

Before localizing a growth-affecting parameter in matter: in Flow-Lenia, a per-parcel uptake gene was selected at the parcel level and bred giant non-dividing cells (seed 3: 1 body, gen 0, high-g matter x17.5). Make the phenotype body-scale (kernel-averaged), or make mutation act on whole bodies. For mcfd cycles, fl_predator's predator layer (mass-conserving kill of overlapped prey matter plus decay to food) gives lagged booms and crashes, although coexistence is a knife edge (1 of 9 points, 3/4 seeds) (origin/claude/alife-flow-lenia:research/alife/threads/flow-lenia/worlds/fl_predator/world.py).

rubric_issues: L7 with matter-carried genes: when the gene is a parcel field and bodies can be mosaics, require a decomposition into between-body (births, deaths, body growth), within-body and fusion terms. A matter-weighted mean is not individual-level evidence. Also define when a takeover after a mutation patch counts as 'change at mutation' (within a stated time of the patch, with no merge) and when it counts as conversion.

A trait that multiplies the growth rate directly (uptake, growth-rate alleles: fl_forager_gene, swimevo) is a positive control for the selection machinery. Say so in the L7 rules, and score it low on novelty and mechanism whatever the rung.

labkit: two-species worlds must use META['species']. In fl_predator, fused segmentation counts predation contacts and remnant regrowth as merges, splits and ~100 nucleations, with 0 persistent tracks. Add a per-body gene readout (body mean and within-body variance) for worlds that carry genes in matter.
Units: require simulation time t, not steps, for every time quoted against a pack. The fl_predator ablations quoted 't~2700' in steps (~t 540).
Process: the r1 review again reached the researcher after the sprint's work was done, so the committee's main experiment ran only as a cut-down first pass.
